more.good_when: A maintainer who breaks how the sheet reader reads a cell sees a test fail, so the invoice and refusals a colleague gets stay as they are. Today these breaks all pass: a description typed over two lines in one cell (Ctrl+Enter) printed with its words run together, a price cell formatted as text holding a negative number such as "-10" (a credit line) getting the plain not-a-number refusal in place of the formatted-as-text one that says how to fix the cell, and a refusal for a column past Z naming the wrong column letter.
